ish: Add watchdog timer This adds support for the watchdog timer (WDT) available on Intel Sensor Hub (ISH). The ISH will reset after T1 expires; see the comments at the top of watchdog.c for further information on this design decision. Originally, we had planned to implement a counter that would disable the WDT after N failures. This was abandoned, since the register used to store the counter was not able to maintain a value across reset on a reliable basis (see b:128679825). paygen: build full DLC payloads Steps this CL performs: 1) Searches available target DLC images in release bucket (example: gs://chromeos-releases/dev-channel/eve-arcnext/9999.0.0/dlc) 2) For each available target DLC images, generate full payload for it. Process on generating a DLC payload: 1) We run DLC payload generation step based on image attribute |dlc_id| (None if not a DLC image). For DLC payload generation: 2) we set partition name (only one) as 'dlc_'+dlc_id. 3) We set target partition (only one) as the image (and we skip partition extraction step). 4) We set source partitions to be empty since we only generate full payload currently and avoid unexpected delta payload to be generated. 5) We skip --new_postinstall_config_file for DLC full payload. More details are in the diffs. arc: mount-passthrough: ACL in mount-passthrough The mount-passthrough is used for ARC++ External Storage. Inside the container, it is initially mounted under /var/run/arc/media/X (where X can be removable or MyFiles paths). This mount point is automatically inherited by application, even when they don't gain READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission. This CL introduces an extra layer of protection at the fuse layer since SELinux doesn't really work on fuse. BUG=b:125742695 TEST=manual test. Support build artifacts for external data files. This change adds support of declaring build artifacts as external data files in the following JSON format: { "type": "artifact", "name": "license_credits.html" } If this JSON is found as *.external in data/ directory, the file at gs://chromeos-image-archive/$BUILDER_PATH/license_credits.html is downloaded to the DUT, where $BUILDER_PATH is a string found as CHROMEOS_RELEASE_BUILDER_PATH in /etc/lsb-release. Afterwards, those files can be accessible in tests with s.DataPath just like other static external data files. chromeos-bootimage: use 0xff as the padding value, more cases Chrome OS firmware images still include large padding spaces set to the value of zero, which makes programming flash chips longer. The chromeos-bootimage ebuild keeps growing, but not all relevant cbfstools invocations are passed the command line parameter requiring filling the padding area with 0xff. This patch fixes a few more instances resulting in elimination of 119K of padding zeros in atlas and fizz firmware images, other boards presumably showing similar improvements. UPSTREAM: lib/lzo: 64-bit CTZ on arm64 LZO leaves some performance on the table by not realising that arm64 can optimize count-trailing-zeros bit operations. Add CONFIG_ARM64 to the checked definitions alongside CONFIG_X86_64 to enable the use of rbit/clz instructions on full 64-bit quantities. video_PlaybackPerf: Run chrome with --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required Chrome autoplay policy is changed [1]. It seems to avoid playing a video in video_PlaybackPerf from time to time.
